<div class="card-body">
'''Fusion Generator Supply Tanks''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">融合ジェネレーター供給タンク</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">宇宙船に配備する。ただし、宇宙船のいる星系と同一星系の、ドッキング・ベイの位置カードが場になければならない。航行速度、戦闘力、回避に＋１する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-36o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">通常の融合技術を使用し、宇宙船にハイパースペース航行のエネルギーを供給する。ドッキング・ベイやアウターリム（辺境）の要所に配備されている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Fusion Generator Supply Tanks.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on a starship. A docking bay location in the same system as the starship must be on table. Add 1 to hyperspeed, power, and maneuver.

'''Lore:''' Uses conventional fusion technology to supply starships with energy for hyperspace travel. Installed in docking bays and at key locations in the Outer Rim.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Fusion Generator Supply Tanks]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
